title: Treat every surface as answers to the reader's questions
problemCues: Marketing or product surface that leads with features instead of reader outcomes
preconditions: Surface a person reads before acting
decision: Every element answers a reader question or is decoration. Name the carrying element for outcome, fit, time-to-value, effort, and trust before polishing.
exceptions: Internal dense ops UIs where the user already knows the job
validatedBy: Copy audit names carrying elements or gaps
